candidate.user_submission: Di pikin no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic or unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 18 months old. E dey cough or e dey get wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count di pikin breath for one whole minute. E no get chest indrawing. Di pikin calm as I check am. Di cough don tey for 3 days. We no get pulse oximeter for here. Di pikin dey get dis kind cough and wheeze before. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute. E no get stridor when e calm. Di pikin dey wheeze.
